title: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a memory misalignment flaw in VMContext layout that…
description: Wasmtime versions 47.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 have a memory misalignment flaw in the VMContext layout. This flaw causes undefined behavior when WebAssembly modules contain an odd number of exception tags, misaligning subsequent host fields in embedders with exceptions enabled. No exploitation path is currently known, and the issue has a low severity rating.
